age_missing_imputation: median across 343, only propensity model; all 245 Cox ages observed
logistic: L2 C=1.0 lbfgs max_iter=5000; all dummy/continuous columns standardized ddof=0
cap_scope: 1st/99th percentiles over all 343, as submitted protocol; 2.5/97.5 and sparse-model cutoffs over observed patients, as legacy code
Cox: unpenalized, corrected full follow-up; state + molecular group + age + sex; robust sandwich SE for weighted models
limitation: Conditional MAR sensitivity only. Weights estimated in the same sample; sandwich SE treats weights as fixed. Residual covariate imbalance and informative missingness may remain; tied event times also limit sandwich approximation. No claim of robustness to MNAR.
propensity_state_reference: Immune-low, preserving the historical Immune-desert reference; dummy order High then Intermediate.
